Organisation
Documentation: A department, arm's length body or other organisation that holds, provides or uses data.

Name: RoleAssignment
Documentation: Who holds an accountability for an asset. Names are held only in the organisation's own records.

Name: DataAsset
Documentation: A critical data asset, or any data set managed by the capability.

Name: Distribution
Documentation: A file, API or other way the asset is made available.

Name: DataSharingAgreement
Documentation: An agreement under which an asset is provided to or acquired from another organisation.

Name: MetadataRecord
Documentation: A catalogue record describing the asset in a metadata standard, with its gap assessment.

Name: DataItem
Documentation: A critical data item (field, table or element) within an asset.

Name: UserNeed
Documentation: A user group of the asset and what quality it needs.

Name: DataQualityActionPlan
Documentation: The DQAP, or equivalent mechanism, for one asset; covers the 7 steps.

Name: QualityRule
Documentation: A data quality rule with its dimension, method and agreed target.

Name: MeasurementRun
Documentation: One assessment of an asset against its rules.

Name: RuleResult
Documentation: The result of one rule in one run.

Name: Issue
Documentation: A rule that misses its target, logged in the Data Issues Log.

Name: RootCause
Documentation: The cause of an issue, found by root cause analysis.

Name: RemediationAction
Documentation: An action to contain, correct or prevent an issue.

Name: Escalation
Documentation: An issue escalated because it is overdue.

Name: CommunicationPlanEntry
Documentation: Who needs to know what about the asset's quality, how and how often.

Name: QualityStatement
Documentation: A plain English statement of an asset's quality, strengths and limitations.

Name: AssetReturn
Documentation: One asset's row in the return to GDS.

Name: AnnualReview
Documentation: The yearly review of an asset, its owner, metadata and DQAP.

Name: Requirement
Documentation: A requirement from policy, guidance or a standard (the requirements register).

Name: MaturityAssessment
Documentation: An organisation's self-assessed data quality maturity, by theme.
